answer: Resource-Entitlement Metering: each agent ID binds to a distinct hardware-attested utility account. A verifier issues random consumption challenges; the meter must sample and sign minimum quantities of nectar (food-grade sugar), timber (packaging grade), and copper (wire grade) within a window. Cloning requires another metered account plus connection and minimum-bundle costs; per-ID rewards are capped below that marginal cost, making clones negative-EV.
